/* This Procedure is a copy from the insert_components procedure from SBCLIB of the section where the BLFA or BLHO interdiction
 should get placed. Because the insert_components does not place the BLFO/BLHO inerdictions on the new components
 if the MOFDIFY process type is passed this procedure will allow for a double check to ensure that the new product gets 
 a BLFO or BLHO placed if the bleed time is slow.*/ -- diptiiabbraham 090905 -- as per Kim 

PROCEDURE CHECK_BL_INTERDICTION(p_unit_id in varchar2,
 p_coll_date in date ,
 p_chapter_id in varchar2,
 p_product_code in varchar2) is 
 
 temp_max_bleed_time number;
 temp_slow_bleed_time number;

 temp_calculated_time VARCHAR2(10);
 temp_blfa_flag varchar2(1);
 temp_contract_id VARCHAR2(9);
 temp_product_type VARCHAR2(5);
 temp_return_val VARCHAR2(1); 
 temp_u_id varchar2(10) := name_in('banner.user_id');
 temp_p_name varchar2(30) := name_in('banner.prog_name'); 
 temp_inter_exists number(2);
 
BEGIN 

 BEGIN
 select ffp_freeze_durn, max_bleed_time, slow_bleed_time
 into temp_ffp_freeze_durn, temp_max_bleed_time, temp_slow_bleed_time
 from chapters
 where chapter_id = p_chapter_id;
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 message('Error in selecting from chapter');
 handle_error;
 END;
 
 BEGIN
 select first_sep_time, second_sep_time,
 third_sep_time, bleed_start_time,
 bleed_end_time, contract_id
 into temp_first_sep_time, temp_second_sep_time,
 temp_third_sep_time, temp_bleed_start_time,
 temp_bleed_end_time, temp_contract_id
 from units
 where unit_id = p_unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(p_coll_date) and
 units.chapter_id = p_chapter_id;

 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting from units');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END; 
 -- check if it is a slow bleed
 IF Round((temp_bleed_end_time-temp_bleed_start_time)*24*60)
 between to_number(temp_slow_bleed_time) and
 to_number(temp_max_bleed_time)
 THEN
 --different from insert_componenets - added to check if the interdiction is already placed on the new product - Diptii 
 select count(1) into temp_inter_exists
 from component_interdictions
 where unit_id = p_unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(p_coll_date) and
 chapter_id = p_chapter_id and
 inter_code IN ('BLFA', 'BLHO');
 
 IF temp_inter_exists = 0 then
 
 temp_blfa_flag := 'N';

 BEGIN
 SELECT distinct 'Y'
 INTO temp_blfa_flag
 FROM master_codes
 WHERE code_type = 'BLFA'
 AND code = temp_product_type
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 temp_blfa_flag := 'N';
 END;
 IF (temp_blfa_flag = 'Y') THEN 
 show_error('9789','BLFA');
 temp_return_val := sbclib.comp_system_interdiction(
 p_unit_id,
 p_coll_date ,
 p_chapter_id,
 p_product_code,
 'BLFA',temp_u_id,
 temp_p_name);
 IF temp_return_val != '0'
 THEN
 message('Interdiction BLFA not assigned to component');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 show_error('9789','BLHO');
 temp_return_val := sbclib.comp_system_interdiction(
 p_unit_id,
 p_coll_date ,
 p_chapter_id,
 p_product_code,
 'BLHO',temp_u_id,
 temp_p_name);
 IF temp_return_val != '0'
 THEN
 message('Interdiction BLHO not assigned to component');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
END;
